skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to analyze demographic trends and patterns, including birth, death, marriage, and migration rates.
Understanding of labor market statistics, including employment, unemployment, and wage data.
Proficiency in statistical methods for analyzing demographic and labor data.
Ability to forecast demographic and labor trends using statistical models.
Skills in collecting and selecting data for demographic and labor analysis.
Proficiency in using statistical software for data analysis and modeling.
Ability to critically evaluate statistical models and economic policies.
Skills in solving problems related to demographic and labor issues.
Understanding of the economic impact of demographic and labor trends.
Ability to evaluate policies based on demographic and labor data.
